description.value: Name a category — corrupted, undead, or machine-possessed — when you cast this. While wielded against a creature of that category, the weapon gains a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls and deals an additional 4d6 damage of its own type on a hit, as though it recalls, briefly, what it was actually forged for.

cinderfall.incomplete: STRUCT-EFFECT-COMPANION: shape is real and buildable (DamageDice + a plain FlatModifier, both predicated on a ChoiceSet-recorded category flag, per pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/actions/class/gunslinger/vital-shot.json's DamageDice precedent), but it is a lasting weapon buff with no companion effect file to carry it -- same structural gap as the resistance spells, compounded with the category-choice plumbing.
